questions.question: A developer needs constant-time average lookups while avoiding pointer overhead in memory-constrained embedded systems. Which collision resolution technique is optimal?

options.A: Separate chaining
options.B: Linear probing

questions.explanation: Linear probing uses open addressing to store keys directly in the array, completely eliminating extra pointer storage overhead.

questions.question: Designing an audio streaming buffer where fixed-size packets are continuously overwritten without dynamic memory reallocation requires which data structure?

options.A: Doubly linked list
options.B: Circular queue

questions.explanation: Circular queues enable constant-time bounded FIFO streaming with automatic index wrapping without dynamic memory allocations.
